text: English department is founded in 1964, aiming to cultivate students with solid English language foundation and extensive scientific culture knowledge. The main focus of the English department is to develop translating, researching, teaching and management skills, which enable the graduates work in departments like foreign affairs, culture, publishing, education, scientific research and tourism as English professionals. Knowledge and abilities that graduates should acquire: Familiarity with the relevant guideline, policy, laws, current situation of China Basic knowledge of linguistics, literature and related humanities science and technology Solid basic knowledge of linguistics and good listening, speaking, reading, writing and translating abilities Know our own national conditions and social science and culture in English speaking countries Good Chinese expression ability and basic research skills Practical use of the second foreign languages Mastering the basic methods and means to search and collect documents, materials and information; having certain scientific research ability The main focus of English department is to develop undergraduate education. Also admit the postgraduates major in foreign linguistics and applied linguistics, English language and literature. Currently there are 36 in-service teachers, including 10 professors (2 doctoral supervisors), retain 6-8 foreign teachers, also there are 17 teachers hold the doctorate diploma. About 90% teachers with master’s degree diploma have the study abroad experiences. Courses Compulsory Courses Basic English, Senior English, Selected Readings of Newspaper & Magazine, English Listening, Speaking and Video, Oral English, English Writing, Translation Theory and Practice, Introduction of Linguistics, History of Literature and Literature Readings Selection of Main English Speaking Countries, National Countries Condition of Main English Speaking Countries. Optional Courses Western Culture, History of Western Civilization, Language and Culture, Stylistics, English History, Scientific English, English Film Appreciation, Business English, Financial English, Tourism English, The Second Foreign Language, Brief Western Economy, International Economy, Introduction of Finance, Laws of Foreign Banks. Main Practical Teaching Concepts Social Survey, Language Practice, Various Foreign Language Contests, Military Training, Graduate thesis. Main Professional Practice Study practices (including exhibitions, oral interpretation and written translation), Work practices (intern in the Ministries of the State Council, news organization, company, etc.) For Further Study Master in foreign language and other social science major home and abroad Students Employment The Ministries of the State Council, News Organization, University, Companies, and etc.
